The coefficient for the μ=λ Wendland endpoint agrees after gamma duplication, without using finite tests as an infinite proof. Independently quadrature-checked three squared-Bessel gamma moments.

Classical Weber–Schafheitlin and Debye are credited as ingredients, not new theorems. Actual primary sections were compared; no checked theorem asserts the all-tail transfer.
